scripts.install:all: cd server && npm install && cd ../client && npm install
scripts.dev: node -e "const { spawn } = require('child_process'); const isWin = process.platform === 'win32'; const npm = isWin ? 'npm.cmd' : 'npm'; const s = spawn(npm, ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: './server', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); const c = spawn(npm, ['run', 'dev'], { cwd: './client', stdio: 'inherit', shell: true }); process.on('SIGINT', () => { s.kill(); c.kill(); process.exit(); });"
